annotations.title: Match remote jobs to a profile

description: Rank live remote jobs against a job seeker's profile (titles, skills, level, country, minimum pay) and say why each fits and what it also asks for. Build the profile from the person's resume or what they told you; only jobs they can take from their country are ranked.

country.description:
Where the person lives: a country name or ISO code. Without it, only
jobs open worldwide are ranked.

min_salary_usd.description: Lowest yearly pay they would accept, in US dollars.

seniority.description: One of: intern, junior, mid, senior, staff, lead, principal, head, director.

skills.description: Skills from their resume or what they said, e.g. ["Rust", "PostgreSQL", "Kubernetes"].

titles.description: Roles the person wants or has held, e.g. ["Backend Engineer", "Platform Engineer"].

name: match_jobs_to_profile
